summary: Prestige Consumer Healthcare Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly owned subsidiary, Prestige Brands, Inc., issued $400 million of 6.250% senior notes due 2034. The notes are senior unsecured obligations, guaranteed on an unsecured senior basis by the parent and certain domestic restricted subsidiaries, with interest payable semiannually starting January 15, 2027. Redemption options include a make-whole call before July 2029, a par call thereafter, and up to 40% redemption with equity offering proceeds. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation; no acquisition, divestiture, or strategic event is disclosed.
